title: THE OFFER LINE NAMES ONE KEY
why: His order of 2026-10-09: a raid line names the key of the device in hand. The trade offer line said T or Y to take it whatever he was holding. It now names one key in brackets: Y on a controller, and the key T is bound to on a keyboard. The parts are split by a middle dot, and the giver sees the item, Waiting and the seconds left.
now: The trade offer line names one take key, the one of the device in hand.
